description: Land Acquisition - Veddukadu, Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in his capacity as the official making the declaration under the Act. The primary focus and substantive content are exclusively about land matters, specifically land acquisition, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
